name: Productboard MCP Server
description: Find, read and update Productboard product specs from Claude, Claude Code or Cursor, post comments and update item status, over a hosted OAuth MCP server.

skills.name: Find Specs
skills.description: Searches Productboard specs by initiative, feature or sub-feature name, by owner, or by tag, within the user's own permissions.

skills.name: Read Specs
skills.description: Pulls the full, current content of any Productboard spec the signed-in user can access into the coding agent's context.

skills.name: Refine Specs
skills.description: Proposes and applies edits to spec content so Productboard stays current as implementation decisions get made.

skills.name: Spec Comments
skills.description: Reads and posts comments on a spec so clarifying questions reach the spec owner instead of getting buried in code.

skills.name: Report Progress
skills.description: Updates a Productboard item's status to reflect where the implementation work stands, notifying teammates.
